text: CHIEF RULING AS AMENDED - implement the scout's shapes (post-01M162EW4GFF1NK35Q54A4G1TW), not the chief's original (c). FIDELITY: no threshold in the estimand; A = summed source-state mass where fidelity is assessable, N = that mass times fidelity, T = eligible units; value N/A explicitly conditional, support A/T, named placement/unassessed residue, A=0 => Missing; per-facet N_f/A_f because Unspecified is ASSESSMENT support and not external placement mass; MAP survives only as an abstaining diagnostic with margin. COMPRESSION: N = sum_i sum_s p_i(s)*level(s)/maxLevel, A = sum_i sourceMass_i, support A/T, value N/A, A=0 Missing. COHERENCE: N = sum_step coherentSourceMass, A = sum_step sourceToSourceMass, support A/eligibleStepCount, value N/A, A=0 Missing. DO NOT divide per unit then average - mean-of-ratios is not ratio-of-sums and gives a 0.01-mass unit the same vote as a fully placed one. VERSIONING: the estimand marker must be DERIVED, never caller-supplied - a caller-set String is an ungrounded assertion, the same defect rejected for portable Sensitivity. Sequence: rework d4443ff's three blocking items first; this lands as its own candidate; do not fold four estimand redefinitions into a block fix.
